function: Joint design of the BS receive beamforming vector and RIS phase shifts that maximizes the devices participating in over-the-air federated aggregation under an MSE constraint (p. 1-2).
system: Uplink AirComp: BS with N=20 antennas, K up to 100 single-antenna devices, reflecting RIS with M=60 unit-modulus phase shifts; carrier frequency not stated (p. 1, 4).
method: Design by alternating optimization, majorization-minimization and projected subgradient (not learned); the model trained is an SVM, MLP or CNN with federated averaging (p. 2, 4).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Rician channels (K-factor 0 for BS-device, 3 otherwise) with distance path loss, exponents 3.6, 2.8, 2.4; FL on MNIST and F-MNIST (p. 4).
test_conditions: No train/test split for the design: sweeps of MSE requirement gamma and device count K; accuracy at round 100 with K=100, gamma=20 dB, M=60 (p. 4-5).
baselines: Oracle-AirComp, DC with SDR [12] (earlier RIS-aided design), CVX interior-point solution of the same problem, random phase, without RIS using the beamformer of [11] (p. 4).
metrics: Number of participating devices, FL classification accuracy over communication rounds and at round 100, and algorithm runtime (p. 4-5).
complexity: Per-iteration order O((N+M)K log2 1/eps) for subgradient, O((N^3+M^3) log2 1/eps) for CVX, O((N^6+M^6) log2 1/eps) for DC; runtimes 5.163, 91.82, 1,227 s (p. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "adopt the Rician channel" - own Rician simulator with its own distance path loss; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "to the total number of devices K." - sweep of K and gamma, each point solved afresh by the optimization; no model trained in one condition and tested in another.
q3_support: p. 4: "higher classification accuracy than DC in Table I." - DC [12] is an earlier published aggregation design; p. 4: "Random phase selects fewer devices than Subgradient, CVX," - random RIS baseline.
q4_support: p. 4: "simple matrix multiplication with the complexity of" O((N+M)K log2 1/eps) for the proposed subgradient; p. 5: "CVX, and DC are 5.163 sec, 91.82 sec, and 1,227 sec," with Subgradient 5.163 sec.
q5_support: p. 4: "MLP, and CNN model with MNIST and F-MNIST" - public dataset of the learning task only; channels are simulated; no code or data link is given.
notes: Over-the-air FL: the learned element is the model trained across devices, so the work passes no_learning, although the beamformer and RIS design is optimization (AO, MM, subgradient; p. 1, 3). Device selection comes from the beamformer (p. 2), so the problem is the aggregation design: area 7. Multi-antenna BS and RIS, so the system check passes. Table I accuracies were read from the page image of p. 4.
